claims.description: Edit-save of a Single-line Text Global Option (GO 969) persists valid changes both from the standalone Edit page and from the 'Edit global option' popup inside the artwork editor (toast 'Saved — Global option has been updated successfully.', value persists after a fresh load). Saving with the required 'Global Option Name (internal)' field empty is blocked with the error toast 'Error — Global Option Name is required' after a POST /api/graphql round-trip (200, GraphQL error-in-body); per the ticket this save path now goes through API validation instead of a direct DB write. Only Single-line Text was verified; other GO types are not covered by this statement.
claims.reason: Testlane PASS record (id + status passed + run date + build) — S3 per §12.3a test_case exception even though the submitter ran it. Run date = TIB-157 done date (Testlane stores no per-case timestamp). Dev comment (po_dev_confirm, author ≠ submitter) is secondary backing, not the chosen type. Covered by TC-TIB-4513 (Edit page), TC-TIB-4514 (artwork-editor popup), TC-TIB-4515 (validation), all passed. Per CCR Phần 4.2 the 'ALL GO types' scope is NOT S3 — only Single-line Text was verified. SUPERSEDES KB-006 (base 2026-09-15, OBSERVED_CURRENT, same GO type text / role owner / surface portal): KB-006 says edit-save sends the client-built Hasura mutation updateGlobalOption (update_global_options_by_pk) — the direct DB write the shipped change (Done 2026-10-05, deployed 2026-10-02) replaced with API validation. Caveat: the TC did not inspect the request body/operation name, so the new operation name is unknown; the superseding statement deliberately says only 'POST /api/graphql'. KB-023 (surface api, same mutation, security note) is probably stale too but was not targeted (scope differs, nothing verified about the new payload) — see overall_decision.

overall_decision: CCR_INGEST, 0 explorers. 8/8 claims S3 (test_case, Testlane task TIB-157), all SHIPPED (Jira Done 2026-10-05 per CCR Phần 3). 7 ADD, 1 SUPERSEDES (CLAIM-03 -> KB-006). New feature_key global-option-additional-option-items (CLAIM-02, 05, 06) needs a FEATURE-ID minted (next free FEAT-03). Follow-ups for the orchestrator: (1) OQ NEEDS_CONFIRMATION for CLAIM-04 'empty Option Title -> no label line' (CCR 4.2, not S3); (2) KB-023 (api surface, security note about the client-built updateGlobalOption mutation) and the profile/checklist items built on KB-006 (CHK-01-007, CHK-01-011, CHK-01-014, profile entries) likely become stale once KB-006 is superseded — needs a human decision or OQ, since the new operation name was not observed; (3) other GO types for the new edit-save path are unverified (CCR 4.2) — coverage gap; (4) the companion contradictions CCR (TIB-5467, 3 failed cases + 1 deviation, incl. the create-screen toggle and locale '- en' issue) is a separate proposal.
